title: Look nice, impossible to iron out folds & wrinkles
text: Look nice, impossible to iron out folds & wrinkles. These drapes look very nice, if only I could get out the folds and wrinkles.  Very frustrating.  I've tried washing and drying, hang drying, ironing, and nothing works.  At least they are not in my main living room!
